'''Mark III Power Guards''' were the third model of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] augmented with the [[Power Guard Enhancement System]]. When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]] acquired control of the Power Guard project, he manufactured Mark III Power Guards using [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] and wiped their minds, transforming them into mindless weapons for him to control. Several Mark III soldiers fought alongside Sadic in his [[Raid on Sadic's laboratory|fight]] with a [[Hero of Tython|young]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="Showdown with Lord Sadic" />
